evidence.summary: Rounds 1-2 unchanged (600 s run limit, per-site spacing, Redis site pause, dead-link back-off). Round 3 on the live worker: runs at 15:00-17:00 took 236-356 s with 175-176 polled; 20:45 run polled 218 in 245 s after the 24 h back-off windows expired. Retention task is bounded (keyset batches of 5000, commit per batch, no new batch after 240 s) and never deletes rows. Laptop sleep 17:29-19:30 and 19:30:38-20:44:27 (Kernel-Power events): no runs while asleep; the 19:30 run stopped on wake via the run limit (time.monotonic counts sleep on Windows) after 31 polled.

rationale: Limits (in addition to rounds 1-2): a fetch that raises (http.client.IncompleteRead, listing 218 at 15:00) is counted failed but leaves no observation row (pre-existing, deferred finding); fetches just before sleep fail with status 0; retention shares the single solo worker (up to 240 s at 03:15).
